title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Apply software engineering practices to infrastructure operations: establish SLOs/SLAs, error budgets, incident automation, and resilience engineering.

goal.objective: Engineer automated systems that maximize platform reliability, maintain rigorous SLOs, and systematically eliminate manual operational toil.

learn.summary: Master Google SRE principles, Service Level Objectives (SLOs), error budgets, incident command systems, chaos engineering (Chaos Mesh), and automated remediation scripting.
key_competencies: Prometheus Alerting Rules & Burn Rate Alerts

capstone_projects.title: Automated Chaos Engineering & SLO Error Budget Suite
capstone_projects.description: Construct an automated chaos testing framework injecting network partitions and container restarts to validate SLO error budgets and self-healing cluster policies.

capstone_projects.title: High-Availability Multi-Region Disaster Recovery Automation
capstone_projects.description: Architect an automated multi-region disaster recovery engine executing health-check routed traffic failover and database replica promotion with verified RTO/RPO limits.

interview_focus: SLI, SLO and SLA Definitions, Error Budget Policies & Burn-Rate Alerting Algorithms
Incident Management Lifecycle (Incident Commander, Postmortem Blameless Culture, Root Cause Analysis)
Site Reliability Engineering Principles (Eliminating Toil, Capacity Planning, Chaos Engineering)
Distributed Systems Resilience Patterns (Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads, Backpressure, Jitter/Backoff)
Observability for High-Scale SRE (Golden Signals: Latency, Traffic, Errors, Saturation)

tree.name: SRE Foundations: Systems, Programming & Principles
tree.description: Establish an uncompromising systems engineering foundation: master Linux kernel execution, network socket behavior, systems programming in Go/Python, distributed systems consensus protocols, and database reliability patterns.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Operating Systems & Networking Deep Dive
children.description: Master Linux kernel internals and network diagnostics: virtual memory management, page cache writeback, swapping behavior, file descriptor limits (`ulimit`, `epoll`), process scheduling (CFS scheduler, CPU pinning), TCP/IP stack tuning (`tcp_tw_reuse`, SYN cookies, TCP window scaling), packet drop analysis, and low-level diagnostic tools (`ss`, `strace`, `lsof`, `tcpdump`, `perf`).

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Programming & Scripting Proficiency
children.description: Master systems automation and tooling development in Go and Python: authoring robust CLI utilities, interacting with cloud provider SDKs and REST/gRPC APIs, implementing parallel execution and retries with exponential backoff and jitter, parsing structured log streams, and writing automated health-check probes.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Distributed Systems Advanced Concepts
children.description: Master distributed systems theory and failure modes: CAP and PACELC theorems, consistency models (strict serializability, linearizability, eventual consistency), consensus algorithms (Raft quorum, leader election, log replication, Paxos), split-brain scenarios, byzantine vs crash-recovery faults, and vector clocks.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Database Fundamentals for SRE
children.description: Engineer database reliability and high availability: write-ahead logging (WAL) mechanics, diagnosing and mitigating replication lag in PostgreSQL and MySQL, connection pooling with PgBouncer / HikariCP, automated failover management (Patroni, Orchestrator), and validating Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) through automated backup restoration tests.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Cloud Native & Infrastructure Automation
tree.description: Automate resilient cloud infrastructure: multi-region architecture, Kubernetes workload resilience, declarative Terraform infrastructure-as-code, and automated configuration management.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Cloud Platforms & Serverless Architectures
children.description: Architect enterprise cloud infrastructure: multi-region active-active and active-passive designs across AWS, GCP, or Azure, VPC routing and Transit Gateways, IAM least-privilege role delegation, cloud egress cost optimization, and operational constraints of serverless runtimes (cold starts, execution timeouts, connection pool exhaustion).

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Containerization & Orchestration
children.description: Master high-availability Kubernetes operations: setting precise resource requests and limits to eliminate CPU throttling and OOMKills, configuring Pod Anti-Affinity across availability zones, Pod Disruption Budgets (PDB) to safeguard uptime, node taints/tolerations, and multi-tier autoscaling with HPA and Karpenter.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
children.description: Implement declarative infrastructure with Terraform / OpenTofu: modular architectures, remote state storage with DynamoDB state locking, drift detection in continuous integration, automated plan testing with Checkov/TFLint, and safe zero-downtime infrastructure rolling updates.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Configuration Management
children.description: Automate fleet configuration with Ansible: writing idempotent playbooks and reusable roles, dynamic cloud inventory integration, managing secrets securely with Ansible Vault, and executing zero-downtime rolling OS kernel patches and security updates.

resources.title: Kubernetes Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)
Prometheus and Grafana Tutorial (TechWorld with Nana)

tree.name: Observability & Proactive Reliability
tree.description: Implement enterprise observability and user-centric reliability: metrics, structured logs, distributed traces, SLOs, error budgets, and actionable low-noise alerting.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Metrics, Logs, and Traces with Tools
children.description: Master the three pillars of observability: Prometheus metric collection (Counters, Gauges, Histograms), authoring advanced PromQL queries (rate, histogram_quantile for p95/p99/p99.9 latency percentiles), structured JSON log shipping with Vector to Grafana Loki, and distributed end-to-end request tracing with OpenTelemetry and Tempo.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Service Level Objectives (SLOs) & Error Budgets Implementation
children.description: Implement Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Error Budgets (Google SRE framework): defining user-centric Service Level Indicators (SLIs), setting mathematical SLO targets, calculating error budget burn rates, implementing Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate alerting to detect both fast and slow budget exhaustion, and enforcing deployment freeze policies when error budgets are breached.

resources.title: Site Reliability Engineering Full Course (TechWorld with Nana)

children.name: Alerting Strategies, Paging & Runbooks
children.description: Design high-signal alerting and on-call operations: eliminating alert fatigue through symptom-based alerting (alerting on user impact, not raw CPU spikes), configuring PagerDuty/Opsgenie escalation policies and rotation schedules, authoring clear and executable runbooks with diagnostic commands, and tracking on-call health and sleep interruptions.

tree.name: Incident Management & Operational Excellence
tree.description: Master incident response and operational discipline: incident command systems, blameless postmortems, toil elimination, and progressive release engineering.

children.name: Incident Response & Blameless Postmortems
children.description: Lead incident response and blameless retrospectives: incident command structure (Incident Commander, Operations Lead, Communications Lead), managing incident war rooms and status pages, conducting blameless postmortems focusing on systemic failure modes, 5-Whys root cause analysis, and tracking preventative engineering action items to completion.

resources.title: SLOs, SLIs, and SLAs Explained (Google Cloud)

children.name: Toil Reduction & Automation Engineering
children.description: Identify, measure, and systematically eliminate operational toil: tracking toil percentage to keep it below 50% of SRE workload, automating recurring operational tasks (TLS certificate rotation, disk space remediation, database failover rehearsals), and building self-service developer tooling to eliminate manual tickets.

children.description: Engineer safe, zero-downtime software releases: progressive delivery pipelines using Argo Rollouts or Flagger (Canary deployments with automated Prometheus metric analysis and instant rollbacks on error spike), feature flagging architectures, and hermetic build verification.
